findings.text: follow-on: the parse_utc/parse_iso definition scan reads only `tree.body`, so a second definition nested in a class, a function or a conditional evades it, whereas the is_section_identity definer check at :167 uses ast.walk and does catch nested definitions; the inconsistent depth leaves the one-definition invariant with a hole the existing owner tests/test_picker_helpers_have_one_owner.py:80 (which uses ast.walk) does not have.

follow-on: the node-identity check passes vacuously at the reviewed head, because set(re.findall(...)) over tests/test_prescription.py is empty (no lowercase hyphenated identity with three or more hyphen groups occurs in that fixture), so `candidates <= set(PRESCRIBED_PROPERTIES)` is True whatever the fixture says; unlike its sibling plan-document check at :292 it carries no non-vacuity guard, so the restored guard is unexercised and would not catch a regression.

follow-on: re-implements a capability the repository already owns without extending its owner, since tests/test_picker_helpers_have_one_owner.py:80 _defined_names and :105 test_no_second_definition_of_an_owned_helper_under_picker already scan a module tree for a second definition of an owned name through ast, and :29 _module_paths duplicates the source enumeration owned by reckon/served_code.py:83 _source_files.
